title: MetaScale: Test-Time Scaling with Evolving Meta-Thoughts
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2026
authors_zh: Qin Liu、Wenxuan Zhou、Nan Xu、James Y. Huang、Fei Wang、Sheng Zhang、Hoifung Poon、Muhao Chen
paper_type_zh: 推理数据、搜索或测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 需要核查推理轨迹、反馈契约、发布边界和复用风险的读者
one_line: MetaScale searches over query-specific cognitive strategies with UCB and LLM-mediated evolution, using an outcome reward model to select the final response under a fixed inference budget.
MetaScale 用 UCB 与模型中介的演化在与问题相关的认知策略上搜索，并在固定推理预算下由结果奖励模型选出最终回答。
why: It provides a concrete schema for auditing strategy-level test-time traces—retrieval source, arm statistics, rewards, evolution lineage, budget, and final selection—without treating benchmark gains as evidence that the hidden traces are reusable or high quality.
inclusion_reason: MetaScale makes strategy proposals, retrieval-derived initialization, bandit statistics, scalar rewards, evolved strategy pools, and final selection explicit test-time trace objects, while leaving the underlying traces unreleased.

title: Problem
问题
html: MetaScale addresses a test-time scaling problem in which a model can sample more responses but still relies on a fixed prompting or reasoning structure. The paper argues that one strategy may not transfer across mathematics, multidisciplinary questions, and open-ended instruction following, so the system should search over how to reason as well as over candidate answers. The paper's auditable unit is a query-specific trajectory containing initial meta-thoughts, selected strategies, candidate responses, scalar reward-model scores, UCB statistics, evolved strategies, and the final highest-scoring response. A meta-thought has two textual fields—a cognitive mindset and a problem-solving strategy. This fits the Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data track because the relevant object is the evolving pool and its selection history, not just the terminal answer. The accepted version appears in Findings of ACL 2026, pages 11828–11842.

MetaScale 研究的测试时扩展问题是：模型即使可以采样更多回答，仍可能受固定 prompting 或 reasoning structure 限制。论文认为，单一策略未必能同时适用于数学、多学科问答和开放式 instruction following，因此系统不仅要搜索候选答案，也要搜索“如何思考”。论文可审计的记录单元是一条逐 query 轨迹，其中包括初始 meta-thought、被选策略、candidate response、标量 reward-model score、UCB statistic、evolved strategy，以及最终得分最高的回答。每个 meta-thought 包含两个文本字段：cognitive mindset 与 problem-solving strategy。它属于 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data 轨道，因为重要对象是持续演化的策略池及其选择历史，而不只是终止答案。正式版本发表于 Findings of ACL 2026，第 11828–11842 页。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: MetaScale has three phases. Initialization asks the target LLM to self-compose task-specific meta-thoughts and also retrieves the top 8 embedding-similar tasks from WildChat, prompting the model to abstract and adapt their strategies. Selection treats each meta-thought as a multi-armed-bandit arm and chooses the largest UCB value, combining the arm's empirical mean Skywork reward with an exploration bonus based on total attempts and selection count. The selected meta-thought conditions a new response, whose scalar reward updates that arm. At every evolution interval (k), high-UCB meta-thoughts become parents and the target LLM generates refined children; the paper does not use literal text-level crossover or mutation. After (T) attempts, the system returns the response with the largest reward-model score. The feedback contract is mixed: a learned outcome reward drives search, exact answer checks evaluate GSM8K, extraction plus answer matching evaluates MMLU-Pro, and an LLM judge evaluates Arena-Hard.

MetaScale 包含三个阶段。初始化阶段先要求 target LLM 自行生成面向当前任务的 meta-thought，再从 WildChat 检索 embedding 相似度最高的 8 个任务，要求模型抽象并适配其中的策略。选择阶段把每个 meta-thought 视为 multi-armed bandit 的一个 arm，并选择 UCB 最大者；UCB 将该 arm 的 Skywork reward 经验均值与依赖总尝试次数和被选次数的 exploration bonus 结合。被选 meta-thought 用于条件化生成新回答，其标量 reward 再更新该 arm。每到 evolution interval (k)，系统选择高 UCB meta-thought 作为 parent，由 target LLM 生成经过改进的 child；论文没有直接执行字面层面的 crossover 或 mutation。完成 (T) 次尝试后，系统返回 reward-model score 最高的回答。反馈契约是 mixed：learned outcome reward 驱动搜索；GSM8K 用精确答案检查；MMLU-Pro 用答案抽取与匹配；Arena-Hard 用 LLM judge 评测。

title: Method
方法
html: Algorithm 1 takes a query, target LLM, reward model, instruction-tuning dataset, attempt budget (T), and evolution interval (k). For each attempt it selects a meta-thought with UCB, generates a response, obtains a score from Skywork-Reward-Llama-3.1-8B-v0.2, updates the arm statistics, and periodically expands the pool from high-UCB parents. The main matched evaluation randomly samples 64 instances from each of GSM8K, MMLU-Pro, and Arena-Hard and applies the same subsets across methods in a zero-shot setting. GPT-4o (gpt-4o-0806) and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct are the target models. Main fixed-budget comparisons use 128 attempts, while scaling analyses range from 1 to 128. The paper explicitly sets greedy one-pass and CoT baselines to temperature 0 and Best-of-N variants to temperature 0.6, but does not separately disclose MetaScale's decoding temperature. GSM8K uses numeric exact match. MMLU-Pro uses two regular-expression extractors and selects a random option if both fail. Arena-Hard uses GPT-4-Turbo to judge against GPT-4-0314 and reports win-rate confidence intervals; additional tables use the full Arena-Hard set with and without style control. UCB β, (k), exact initial-pool size, seeds, and sampled item IDs remain unknown.

Algorithm 1 的输入包括 query、target LLM、reward model、instruction-tuning dataset、尝试预算 (T) 与 evolution interval (k)。每次尝试中，系统用 UCB 选择 meta-thought，生成回答，由 Skywork-Reward-Llama-3.1-8B-v0.2 打分，更新 arm statistic，并周期性地从高 UCB parent 扩展策略池。主对比从 GSM8K、MMLU-Pro 与 Arena-Hard 各随机抽取 64 个样本，在所有方法间复用相同子集，并采用 zero-shot 设置。Target model 为 GPT-4o（gpt-4o-0806）与 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。主固定预算对比使用 128 次尝试，scaling analysis 的预算从 1 变化到 128。论文明确将 greedy one-pass 与 CoT baseline 的 temperature 设为 0，将 Best-of-N 变体设为 0.6，但没有单独披露 MetaScale 的 decoding temperature。GSM8K 使用数值精确匹配；MMLU-Pro 使用两套正则抽取，若均失败则随机选择一个选项；Arena-Hard 使用 GPT-4-Turbo 相对 GPT-4-0314 进行 judging，并报告 win-rate confidence interval；另有表格在完整 Arena-Hard 上分别采用和不采用 style control。UCB β、(k)、精确初始池大小、seed 与抽样条目 ID 仍为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Table 1 reports that, on the shared 64-item subsets, MetaScale has the highest listed GPT-4o score on Arena-Hard, MMLU-Pro, and GSM8K, and the highest listed Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct score on Arena-Hard and MMLU-Pro. The evidence is not uniformly favorable: for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on GSM8K, adding evolution lowers the reported accuracy from 84.38 to 82.81, although both exceed the listed baselines. Figure 2 shows steeper gains than Best-of-N as the GPT-4o sampling budget rises from 1 to 128 on Arena-Hard and MMLU-Pro. On the full Arena-Hard set with style control, Table 2 reports MetaScale-128 at 80.1 and o1-mini at 79.2 with overlapping 95% confidence intervals; without style control, Table 3 reports 89.0 for MetaScale-128 and 92.0 for o1-mini. These comparisons support evaluation of the studied search policy but expose sensitivity to model, task, subset, judge, and style control. They do not demonstrate that unreleased meta-thoughts, retrieved examples, UCB logs, or reward scores are accurate, licensed, or suitable as training data.

Table 1 显示：在共享的 64 条子集上，MetaScale 在 Arena-Hard、MMLU-Pro 与 GSM8K 中取得表内最高的 GPT-4o 分数，并在 Arena-Hard 与 MMLU-Pro 中取得表内最高的 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 分数。但证据并非全面有利：在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的 GSM8K 设置中，加入 evolution 后报告准确率从 84.38 降至 82.81，尽管二者都高于表中 baseline。Figure 2 显示，当 GPT-4o 的 sampling budget 从 1 增至 128 时，MetaScale 在 Arena-Hard 与 MMLU-Pro 上的增幅比 Best-of-N 更陡。对完整 Arena-Hard 采用 style control 时，Table 2 报告 MetaScale-128 为 80.1、o1-mini 为 79.2，且二者 95% confidence interval 重叠；不采用 style control 时，Table 3 则报告 MetaScale-128 为 89.0、o1-mini 为 92.0。这些对比支持对所研究 search policy 的评测，同时也揭示结果对模型、任务、子集、judge 与 style control 的敏感性；它们不能证明未发布的 meta-thought、检索样例、UCB log 或 reward score 是正确、获许可或适合用作训练数据的。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior test-time methods commonly sample answers under one prompt, refine a response, or search with a verifier. MetaScale changes the search variable: each arm is a textual strategy rather than an answer, and the pool itself changes during inference. Its initialization combines model-authored strategies with abstractions from retrieved WildChat examples; its selector uses accumulated arm rewards rather than scoring independent candidates only; and its LLM-mediated evolution produces new strategy arms from high-UCB parents. Genetic algorithms, UCB, retrieval, personas, meta-reasoning, and reward-model selection are not individually new. The contribution is their query-local integration into a fixed-budget strategy-search trajectory. For this atlas, that trajectory is the novelty signal: the lineage between retrieved examples, parent and child strategies, arm statistics, candidate responses, and final selection should be retained if the method is ever released as data.

既有 test-time 方法通常在同一 prompt 下采样答案、修订回答，或借助 verifier 搜索。MetaScale 改变的是搜索变量：每个 arm 是文本策略而不是答案，并且策略池本身会在推理期间变化。其初始化把模型自行生成的策略与从 WildChat 检索样例中抽象的策略结合；selector 使用累积 arm reward，而不只是独立地给候选打分；LLM-mediated evolution 又从高 UCB parent 生成新的策略 arm。Genetic algorithm、UCB、retrieval、persona、meta-reasoning 与 reward-model selection 各自都不是新概念；贡献在于把它们按 query 集成为固定预算的 strategy-search trajectory。对本图谱而言，这条轨迹才是新意信号：若方法未来以数据形式发布，应保留 retrieved example、parent/child strategy、arm statistic、candidate response 与 final selection 之间的 lineage。

title: Limitations
局限
html: MetaScale optimizes and finally selects with the same outcome reward model, so reward-model error can be reinforced through both UCB updates and terminal selection; the paper does not provide a separate calibration or adversarial robustness study. Retrieval provenance is incomplete: WildChat is named and top-8 similarity is reported, but the dataset version, embedding model, index, retrieved IDs, and contamination checks are not disclosed. Important execution settings—UCB β, evolution interval (k), exact initial-pool size, MetaScale decoding temperature, and seeds—remain unknown. The main matched tables use only 64 random items per benchmark without released identities. Arena-Hard results change under style control, and MMLU-Pro assigns a random option after extraction failure. The authors identify English-only tasks and single-model experiments as limitations; only two target models are evaluated. No official code, meta-thought pool, reward log, UCB history, generated-response set, or sample manifest was verified. The ACL paper's CC BY 4.0 status does not establish reuse rights for WildChat-derived records or generated traces.

MetaScale 使用同一个 outcome reward model 优化搜索并完成最终选择，因此 reward-model error 可能同时通过 UCB update 与 terminal selection 被强化；论文没有提供独立的 calibration 或 adversarial robustness 研究。Retrieval provenance 并不完整：论文说明使用 WildChat 并报告 top-8 相似检索，但未披露 dataset version、embedding model、index、retrieved ID 与 contamination check。UCB β、evolution interval (k)、精确初始池大小、MetaScale decoding temperature 与 seed 等关键执行设置仍为 unknown。主对比表每个 benchmark 只使用 64 个随机样本，且未发布样本身份。Arena-Hard 结果会随 style control 改变，MMLU-Pro 在抽取失败后还会随机指定选项。作者将仅使用英文任务和单模型实验列为局限；评测也只覆盖两个 target model。未核验到官方代码、meta-thought pool、reward log、UCB history、generated-response set 或 sample manifest。ACL 论文的 CC BY 4.0 状态并不等于 WildChat-derived record 或生成轨迹具有可复用许可。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For the Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data track, MetaScale suggests a strategy-level trace schema: benchmark item and retrieval query; retrieved WildChat IDs and similarity scores; initial cognitive mindsets and problem-solving strategies; arm selection counts, empirical means, UCB values, and β; every selected meta-thought, generated response, and scalar reward; evolution interval, parent set, child strategies, and lineage; attempt budget; final argmax response; and an evaluation result kept separate from the search reward. Such records could support studies of exploration versus exploitation, retrieval influence, strategy diversity, reward hacking, and scaling efficiency. The paper supports test-time construction and evaluation use, not SFT, preference training, or RL reuse. Without a released trace set and licenses, this remains a schema inferred from the method rather than an available dataset.

对 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data 轨道而言，MetaScale 提示了一套 strategy-level trace schema：benchmark item 与 retrieval query；检索到的 WildChat ID 与 similarity score；初始 cognitive mindset 和 problem-solving strategy；arm selection count、empirical mean、UCB value 与 β；每次被选 meta-thought、生成回答与标量 reward；evolution interval、parent set、child strategy 与 lineage；attempt budget；最终 argmax response；以及与 search reward 分开保存的 evaluation result。这类记录可支持 exploration/exploitation、retrieval influence、strategy diversity、reward hacking 与 scaling efficiency 研究。论文证据支持测试时构造和评测用途，不支持 SFT、preference training 或 RL 复用。由于没有发布轨迹集和相应许可，这仍是从方法推导出的 schema，而不是已经可用的数据集。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 2.2–2.4 as a trace specification: top-8 WildChat retrieval, UCB arm selection, reward update, and LLM-mediated evolution are separate events.
  • The main matched results use 64 random items per benchmark and 128 attempts; exact item IDs and seeds are not released.
  • MetaScale's decoding temperature, UCB β, evolution interval (k), and exact initial-pool size remain unknown.
  • Compare Tables 2 and 3: Arena-Hard ranking changes with style control, and the style-controlled confidence intervals overlap.
  • Benchmark gains evaluate a selector; they are not evidence that the hidden meta-thoughts, reward logs, or retrieved examples are high-quality reusable data.

• 应把 Section 2.2–2.4 作为轨迹规范阅读：top-8 WildChat retrieval、UCB arm selection、reward update 与 LLM-mediated evolution 是不同事件。
  • 主匹配实验每个 benchmark 使用 64 个随机样本和 128 次尝试；精确条目 ID 与 seed 未发布。
  • MetaScale decoding temperature、UCB β、evolution interval (k) 与精确初始池大小仍为 unknown。
  • 应对照 Table 2 与 Table 3：Arena-Hard 排名会随 style control 改变，style-controlled confidence interval 也相互重叠。
  • Benchmark 提升评估的是 selector，不能证明隐藏的 meta-thought、reward log 或 retrieved example 是高质量可复用数据。
